newsitem.title: UK: UBS says DAPS in Hanson begins trading.
newsitem.headline: UBS says DAPS in Hanson begins trading.

text.p: UBS, which began trading Demerger Advance Participation Securities (DAPS) in Hanson's four demerged companies on Wednesday, said DAPS in Millennium Chemicals started at $29.37/$31.55.

DAPS in the Energy Group started at 520p/540p, while DAPS in Imperial Tobacco began at 340p/360p. DAPS in the new Hanson Plc, consisting mainly of building materials companies in the UK and U.S., started at 43p/45p.

DAPS were designed to allow investors reorganise holdings before trading in the underlying securities of the demerged organization commences. They may be swapped for shares as the demerger, beginning October 1, proceeds.
UBS had valued Imperial between 36p and 41p, according to the details of the DAPS issue. Millennium was indicated at $27.24 to $32.68, Energy at 67p and Hanson between 44p and 49p.

The shares in Millenium and Imperial are expected to start trading in New York and London, respectively in early October. However, the listing on the Energy Group is unlikely to start before the first quarter of 1997, UBS said.
